ticker_news.title: S&P 500: Key Weekly Levels and Price Targets
ticker_news.description: The article provides an overview of S&P 500 futures, highlighting key technical developments and potential trading zones for the upcoming week, with a focus on market movements and strategic price targets.
ticker_news.author: Patrick Munnelly

ticker_news.title: S&P 500: Could Forward Earnings and Fed Cuts Spark a 1999-Style Rally?
ticker_news.description: The stock market is experiencing record highs driven by better-than-expected earnings and the Fed's rate cut. Analysts draw parallels to the 1999 Tech Bubble, suggesting potential for a market rally followed by potential correction.
ticker_news.author: Ed Yardeni
